entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `GetAsyncIterationType` incorrectly returns a synchronous iteration type for arrays #86339
  • EnC: updating a method whose signature uses a `[CreateNewOnMetadataUpdate]` type retypes it in place, so unchanged callers pass the original type and corrupt the heap #86338
    Backlog
  • Hot Reload reports source generator errors from an old snapshot after the errors are fixed #86336
  • IntelliSense Suggests Incompatible Code Fixes for Multi-Target Framework Projects #86335
  • FSA diagnostics cache ignores analyzer filter changes on an unchanged project #86334

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix LSP protocol serialization and icon equality #86342
    Community, VSCode
  • [Reference only - do not merge] Replace Roslyn protocol types with generated models #86341
    Community, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • fix GetAsyncIterationType for arrays #86340
    Community, VSCode
  • Remove Razor's VS protocol model dependencies #86337
    Community, Needs API Review, Area-Razor

Merged

  • Add project-system APIs to Visual Studio ExternalAccess #86192
    Next

Updated

  • Handle ref field dereference failures without aborting expansion #85967
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Migrate tests to xUnit v3 #85776
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3128662 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Fix false positive CS8619 for byte? compound assignment #82894
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Migrate ContainedLanguage to the generated protocol assembly #86302
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Lock object: fix CFG with nullable differences #86323
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove project-system InternalsVisibleTo grants #86194
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86186
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86318
  • Add a fixall in document LSP code action #86229
    VSCode
  • Ensure that Length getter cannot change reference-type receiver before implicit indexing or slicing completes #86330
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix nullable annotation warning from nameof emission for a generic component parameter #86311
    Community, Area-Razor
